zh.title: 美國空軍授予 Boeing 22 架 F-15EX 合約　金額 23.8 億美元
zh.summary: 美國空軍第 7 批 F-15EX 採購包含 22 架戰機，合約金額 23.8 億美元，使 Boeing 獲得合約的 F-15EX 總數增至 120 架。
body: Boeing 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日宣布，美國國防部已授予該公司一份金額 23.8 億美元的合約，為美國空軍生產 22 架 F-15EX Eagle II。這批採購屬於 F-15EX 生產第 7 批，代表合約正式涵蓋製造，尚不等於 22 架飛機已完成交付。
第 7 批合約生效後，Boeing 已取得第 1 批至第 7 批的完整生產合約，F-15EX 合約總數增至 120 架。Boeing 也表示，近期交付的 F-15EX-22 是第 3 批合約下的首架飛機。
依 Boeing 公布的時程，公司將在 2026 年剩餘期間持續交付第 3 批飛機，並與美國空軍合作，朝每月生產 2 架 F-15EX 的目標提升產率。這是製造商公布的生產目標，公告沒有提供第 7 批 22 架飛機的逐架交付日期。
F-15EX 是 Eagle 系列的最新版本。Boeing 公布的配置包括數位線傳飛控、全玻璃化座艙、現代化任務系統，以及 AESA 雷達與 EPAWSS 電子戰系統；這些是製造商列出的機型能力。

en.title: U.S. Air Force awards Boeing $2.38 billion contract for 22 F-15EX fighters
en.summary: The Lot 7 award covers 22 F-15EX aircraft and raises Boeing's total number of F-15EX fighters under U.S. Air Force contract to 120.
body: Boeing announced on September 29, 2026 that the U.S. Department of Defense had awarded it a $2.38 billion contract to manufacture 22 F-15EX Eagle II aircraft for the U.S. Air Force. The procurement is Lot 7 of F-15EX production. It is a manufacturing award, not a statement that the 22 aircraft have already been delivered.

With the Lot 7 award, Boeing is under contract for full production across Lots 1 through 7, bringing the total number of F-15EX aircraft under contract to 120. Boeing also said the recently delivered F-15EX-22 was the first aircraft from the Lot 3 contract.

Boeing plans to continue delivering Lot 3 aircraft during the remainder of 2026 and to work with the U.S. Air Force toward increasing production to two F-15EX aircraft per month. This is the manufacturer's stated production goal; the announcement did not provide individual delivery dates for the 22 Lot 7 aircraft.

The F-15EX is the latest version of the Eagle family. Boeing lists digital fly-by-wire controls, an all-glass cockpit, modern mission systems, an AESA radar and the EPAWSS electronic-warfare suite among its features. These capability descriptions come from the manufacturer.

facts.claim: Boeing announced on 2026-09-29 that the U.S. Department of Defense awarded it a $2.38 billion contract to manufacture 22 F-15EX aircraft for the U.S. Air Force.
The award covers Lot 7, puts Boeing under contract for Lots 1 through 7, and raises the total F-15EX quantity under contract to 120.
F-15EX-22 was the first Lot 3 aircraft delivered; Boeing says Lot 3 deliveries will continue through the rest of 2026 while it works toward two aircraft per month.
Boeing lists digital fly-by-wire controls, an all-glass cockpit, modern mission systems, AESA radar and EPAWSS among the F-15EX's features.
